1. A board game with complexity rating < 2.5 and supports more than 5 players. Use board_game_search with complexity=2.5, player_count=5? Actually "supports more than 5 players" means min player count <=? Wait board_game_search expects "minimum player count". So we need a board game with min player count <=? So we call board_game_search with complexity=2.5, player_count=5.
